offence_category.correct_value: Murder as charged; finally culpable homicide not amounting to murder (s.304 Part II)
offence_category.quote: committed culpable homicide without premeditation in a sudden fight
offence_category.reason: Murder was the trial charge, but the final conviction was culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302, s.304 Part II, s.307, s.342; s.84 and Evidence Act s.105 considered
statutory_provisions.quote: convict the appellant under section 304 Part-II
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.304 Part II, the final conviction provision, and s.84/s.105 discussed.

weapon.reason: Sharp edged cutting weapon (Aruval) used against wife and mother is supported.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness (PW2), medical, and circumstantial evidence are all relied upon.

confession.reason: No confession is recorded as such by the court.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Assaults on wife and mother, weapon use, and confinement are all described.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Court found no premeditation, heat of passion, and no intention to cause death.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Life for murder, 10 years RI for s.307 counts, and 1 year for s.342 match the judgment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: HC upheld s.302, s.307 (one count for PW2) and s.342; SC reduced s.307 sentence to 7 years
high_court_outcome.quote: sentence awarded to him for offences punishable under Sections 302, 307 (one count- for attempted murder of PW2) and 342
high_court_outcome.reason: HC upheld only one s.307 count; the reduction to 7 years was by the Supreme Court.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal partly allowed; convicted under s.304 Part II; s.302 conviction set aside
final_outcome.quote: convict the appellant under section 304 Part-II
final_outcome.reason: 'Convicted' omits that the murder conviction was altered to s.304 Part II.

offence_finally_established.reason: Final conviction is culpable homicide not amounting to murder under s.304 Part II.

imprisonment_type.reason: Rigorous imprisonment for a fixed term is ordered.

imprisonment_years.reason: Final sentence under s.304 Part II is ten years rigorous imprisonment.

fine_rs.quote: together with a fine of Rs.1,000/- for each of the offences punishable under Section 307
fine_rs.reason: Trial court imposed Rs.1,000 fine per s.307 count; null omits this stated fine.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts only, without stating the modified conviction or the court's outcome.
neutral_facts.quote: convict the appellant under section 304 Part-II
neutral_facts.reason: Summary reveals the outcome by stating conviction was modified to culpable homicide.

offence_severity.correct_value: Final: 10 years RI (s.304 Part II); 7 years RI (s.307); 1 year (s.342). Trial: life, 10 years, 1 year.
offence_severity.quote: reduced sentence of seven years rigorous imprisonment
offence_severity.reason: Lists trial sentences only; omits the final sentences that replaced them.

physical_harm.reason: Daughter's death and injuries to wife and mother are supported.

number_of_offences.reason: Charges and upheld counts match the judgment.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss from the offence is stated.

motive.reason: Judgment identifies a property-sale dispute and blame of wife as the motive.

witness_credibility.reason: PW2 found reliable, PW1 and PW8 corroborative, PW3 hostile and discounted.

legal_representation.quote: K.K. Mani, Abhishek Krishna, Mayur R. Shah for the Appellant

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court upheld, and Supreme Court modification are accurately sequenced.

prosecution_argument.reason: Summary of prosecution case matches the judgment's account.

defence_argument.reason: Summary of insanity arguments matches the judgment.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Burden under s.84 on accused and lower standard under s.105 are correctly stated.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Dahyabhai, Ram Swarup and Bhikari are cited as stated.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court's reasoning on no premeditation, heat of passion and s.304 Part II is accurately summarised.
